BombVault 7.7.0 lets you create a folder while choosing a backup location and gives VMs their own backup order, with live drag-and-drop reordering.

## Added

- **Create a new folder while choosing a backup location.** The folder picker now has a "New folder" field: type a name, create it, and BombVault drops you straight into the new folder so you can select it. No more switching to a file manager just to make a destination folder first.

- **VMs now have their own backup order.** Just like containers, you can set the exact order your scheduled VM run backs your VMs up in. Open the VMs tab (Advanced), arrange the list, and the scheduled run follows it. VMs you leave off the list run afterwards, in name order.

## Improved

- **Reordering the backup order is now live.** When you drag a container or VM to a new spot in the backup-order list, the other rows shift out of the way immediately as you drag, instead of only settling when you drop. The up and down arrows still work for keyboard reordering.

## Maintenance

- The new interface text is translated into all 26 languages.

## Upgrading

Just pull the new image.
